policies.B1: A carrier receives transit authorization whenever fleet volume reaches at least 10 motorcoaches, Gold Safety Transport Accreditation is maintained, or client satisfaction reaches a minimum rating of 4.5 points.
policies.D1: Selection for key enterprise travel agreements requires a transit authorized carrier that maintains minimum indemnification protection of 5000000 USD.
policies.B2: A shuttle service achieves preferred vendor standing when its quarterly arrival timeliness equals or exceeds 90 percent.
policies.B3: A maritime operator receives approval for international charter operations upon maintaining a certified maritime safety record.

decoy_policies: An airport ground handler earns premium terminal access when holding an active baggage handling certification and maintaining a quarterly baggage loss rate below 0.1 percent.
